title: ComfyUI-zveroboy-photo for RAW Workflow and Photorealism
summary: A suite of ComfyUI nodes for advanced post-processing, RAW image manipulation, and sensor noise simulation. It facilitates professional photography workflows by supporting DNG output and camera-specific EXIF metadata integration.
research_notes: Includes tools specifically designed to make AI-generated images appear as genuine photographs to bypass AI detection signatures.

evolution.summary: Transitioned from simple noise-addition tools to a sophisticated engine for RAW/DNG workflows, including authentic sensor noise modeling (Shot and Read noise) and professional camera metadata presets.
